```{r adiv_table1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=length(tabInfo$adiv) >= 1 && !is.null(tabInfo$adiv[[1]])}
if (length(tabInfo$adiv) >= 1 && !is.null(tabInfo$adiv[[1]])) {
adiv_table <- as.data.frame(tabInfo$adiv[1])

if (!is.null(adiv_table$se.chao1)) adiv_table$se.chao1 <- round(adiv_table$se.chao1, 3)
if (!is.null(adiv_table$Shannon))  adiv_table$Shannon  <- round(adiv_table$Shannon, 3)

  adiv_table$PD <- round(adiv_table$PD, 3)
}
adiv_table$Description <- NULL

datatable(adiv_table, extensions = 'Buttons', options = list(
  dom = 'frtipB',
  buttons = c('excel','csv'),
  pageLength = 100,
  scrollX = TRUE,
  scrollY = "300px"
))
}
```

```{r Go_adiv, include=FALSE}
  convert_and_include_pdf <- function(tool, index, subgroup = NULL, wd, adivplot) {
    pattern <- sprintf("%s.*\\(%s\\)%s.*\\.pdf$",tool,  adivplot[index], ifelse(is.null(subgroup), "", paste0(".*", subgroup)))
    input_pdf <- list.files(path = wd, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
    
    if(length(input_pdf) == 0) {
      message("No PDF files found for pattern: ", pattern)
      return()
    }
    
    if (length(input_pdf) > 1) {
    
      message("Multiple PDF files matched pattern: ", pattern, " - using the first: ", basename(input_pdf[1]))
    
    }
    
    base_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(input_pdf[1]))
    output_png <- file.path(dirname(input_pdf[1]), paste0(base_name, ".png"))
    
    image_read_pdf(input_pdf[1], pages = 1) %>%
      image_convert(format = "png") %>%
      image_write(output_png)

    return(output_png)
  }
```


```{r render_plot_series_helper, include=FALSE}
render_plot_series <- function(tool, plot_names, wd, widths = NULL) {
  if (length(plot_names) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (i in seq_along(plot_names)) {
    plot_name <- plot_names[[i]]
    if (is.null(plot_name) || is.na(plot_name) || !nzchar(as.character(plot_name))) {
      next
    }

    w <- if (!is.null(widths) && length(widths) >= i && !is.na(widths[i])) widths[i] else "100%"

    cat("#### ", plot_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
    output_png <- convert_and_include_pdf(tool, i, subgroup = NULL, wd = wd, adivplot = plot_names)
    if (!is.null(output_png)) {
      cat(sprintf(
        "<div style=\"text-align:center;\"><img src=\"%s\" style=\"max-width:%s; height:auto;\" /></div>\n\n",
        output_png, w
      ))
    }
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r adiv_plots, echo=FALSE, results='asis', fig.align='center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
render_plot_series("box", imgInfo$adivplot, dirInfo$image.wd, imgInfo$adivplot_width)
```

```{r fore_plots, echo=FALSE, results='asis', fig.align='center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

```
